inputs.name: name
inputs.label: VM name: 1-64 letters, digits or -, not starting or ending with -.

inputs.name: resource_group_name
inputs.label: Existing resource group, e.g. the name output of the resourcegroup module.

inputs.name: location
inputs.label: Azure region, e.g. westeurope. Must match the subnet's region.

inputs.name: subnet_id
inputs.label: ID of an existing subnet for the VM's network interface.

inputs.name: admin_username
inputs.label: Admin user. Azure rejects reserved names like admin or root.

inputs.name: admin_password
inputs.label: Admin password, required for Windows (12-123 chars, Azure complexity rules).

inputs.name: ssh_public_key
inputs.label: OpenSSH public key for the admin user, required for Linux (ssh-rsa, 2048 bits or more).
